concerns.text: The Parameter Coverage Score (FR-003) measures the proportion of AST‑defined parameters that appear in the generated docstring, yet the generation prompt (FR-002 / FR-012) consists solely of the method signature, which already contains those parameter names. This creates a circular validation: the predictor (LLM output) is given exactly the information the metric evaluates, allowing trivial high scores by copying the signature. Using this metric as the primary evidence of documentation completeness violates the independence requirement for a sound scientific claim.
